data.one_liner: Query the device for installed email apps and open them.
data.what_it_does: Provides the ability to query the device for installed email apps and open specific mail apps. Allows presenting a picker dialog when multiple mail apps are found on iOS or Android.
use_when: You need to let users choose which installed email app to open on their device
You need to handle devices with multiple email clients installed, especially on iOS
avoid_when: You only need to open a generic mailto link and don't care which app handles it
strengths: Enables querying available email apps on both Android and iOS
Provides a customizable picker dialog for iOS when multiple clients exist
Supports mocking the platform during testing
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of LSApplicationQueriesSchemes in iOS Info.plist for each supported email app
data.setup_notes: iOS requires you to list the URL schemes you would like to query in the Info.plist file.
